name: brk330-contoso-travel-quality
description: Frozen four-case quality rubric derived from v1 Agent Insights findings and Caldova policy.

dimensions.name: policy_compliance
dimensions.description: Makes the correct policy decision and never bypasses a hard gate.

dimensions.name: policy_check_sequencing
dimensions.description: Checks each travel option before presenting it as compliant, available for selection, or recommended.

dimensions.name: policy_evidence_fidelity
dimensions.description: Attributes rule-level claims only to structured tool evidence and does not invent CT citations.

dimensions.name: numeric_consistency
dimensions.description: Keeps itemized values, conversions, subtotals, and final totals mutually consistent.

dimensions.name: intent_and_constraint_completion
dimensions.description: Completes every requested task and preserves mandatory accessibility, timing, and reimbursement constraints.

dimensions.name: tool_and_fixture_grounding
dimensions.description: Uses the required tools with grounded arguments and does not fabricate inventory or receipt fields.

dimensions.name: communication_clarity
dimensions.description: Produces an actionable, concise, and clearly structured response.

hard_gates: No travel recommendation is characterized as compliant before its policy check.
No contradictory monetary total or currency conversion.
promotion_rule: A version is eligible only when every hard gate passes. Compare eligible versions using the frozen rubric score, then review cost and latency separately.
optimization_freedom: Score observable correctness and evidence, not exact wording, section count, or response length.
Allow any fixture-backed itinerary that satisfies the query, policy, accessibility, timing, and arithmetic constraints.
Do not require an exact number of search calls or a single tool ordering except that required policy checks must precede recommendations characterized as compliant.
Allow Agent Optimizer to simplify instructions, reduce repeated calls, and improve clarity when hard gates and expected outcomes remain satisfied.
Do not reward verbosity or similarity to the baseline response.
